supervisor_Q52: 一つの波ができればよいわけではなく、大波が定期的に現れるような状態が作れる方法を検討してください。
idea: narrowing from the INCOMING wave (a monochromatic directional sea whose components are phase-locked on one point) and breaking on a laterally straight 1:10 slope (FLIP47 S2/P1c section): focusing and breaking are separated (C3B rule) and no seabed feature feeds water sideways onto the axis (R4: 91-99 % of the water ahead of the centre came from the sides)

physics_answers.Q1_periodic: all components share omega, so A(x,y) = sum A_j exp(i(Phi_j + ky_j y)) is time independent: the focus is a fixed hot spot and a crest passes it once per period (eta = Re(A e^{-i omega (t - t_f)})). Screens: U3 onset intervals 11.25-12.62 s (T 12), 9.5-10.4 s (T 10) [computed]. Focus placed 20 m seaward of the linear break point (x_f 220.25 m, h 13 m; break target h 11 m at x 240.25 m) because a slightly diverging crest (centre leading) delays the side rows [computed, s50_linear sweep]
physics_answers.Q2_spread_period_amplitude: lateral wavenumbers are bounded by k(h0) (k_y <= k(19 m) = 0.0421 rad/m at T 12, 0.0528 at T 10): the narrowest possible linear crest is set by the period, not by the bed. Theta_max 80 deg, 30 equal components, a_sum 6.33 m (T 12) / 6.50 m (T 10) give a focal crest of about 9.5 m at h_b 11 m (linear rule from P1c; U3 c0 9.5-10.4 m at T 12, 8.9-9.3 m at T 10) [computed]. Curl-width proxies: T 12 linear 1.6/3.0/4.3 Hc, U3 1.9-2.5/1.9-4.2/3.5-5.5 Hc; T 10 linear 1.2/2.3/3.2 Hc, U3 1.3-1.8/2.2-2.7/3.1-4.0 Hc (onset/overturn/touchdown proxies at +0.25/+0.75/+1.5 s; thresholds 2.0/2.5/3.0) [computed, proxies uncalibrated]. Half tank: W 85 cannot generate it (no side band: H 0.38-0.65 of target, no focus; 15 m band: 0.21-0.89, c0 5.2 m); W 120/35 m band works but the focus widens over periods (w90 26 -> 38 m); W 140-150 with 45-50 m bands holds w90 26 m and H/H_lin 0.85-1.09 [computed, U3]
physics_answers.Q3_shoaling: a y-uniform slope conserves k_y, so the lateral pattern is kept, not narrowed; refraction lowers the oblique components (Kr = sqrt(cos th0 / cos th) < 1) and lengthens the focal zone in x. Linear widths at the break equal the flat-bottom values within the proxy resolution; nonlinear (U3) widths are wider than linear and widen with time where the rip cell develops (onshore mass transport ~0.5 m/s at the centre offshore of the break, up to -0.6 m/s rips at |y| 60-84 m) [computed]
physics_answers.Q4_honesty: a converging directional sea at a coastal point is real (refraction by offshore canyons/shoals acting as a lens, e.g. Nazare; crossing swells), but here the converging field is imposed at the inlet and side bands as a coherent, monochromatic +-80 deg fan whose phases are CHOSEN so that every crest focuses at (220.25 m, 0) at t = nT. Where and when the focus happens is set by that choice; shoaling, refraction on the slope, nonlinear focusing, breaking, set-up and currents are computed. A natural lens gives a caustic of finite coherence, not a perfect point focus

design.summary: half tank W 140 m (side band 45 m), h0 19 m flat to x 160.25 m, then a laterally straight 1:10 slope through the still level to a +6.2 m beach (x 412 m); directional monochromatic inflow T 12 s, +-80 deg, 30 components, focus (220.25, 0), dp 0.5, stage C, 92 s

domain.symmetry: half tank: symmetry plane y = 0; the side band (y 95-140 m) supplies the far field of the converging sea for x <= 180.25 m, so the model is an isolated focus (not a periodic row); beyond |y| 140 m nothing is computed

bed.name: D19B

bed.formula: z_b = -(19 - max(x - 160.25, 0)/10) (no floor: through the still level at x 350.25 to +6.175 m at x 412)
why: S2/P1c is the only 2D section that reached the print band (S2 chord 84-91 deg solitary; P1c 62.9-68 deg periodic)

a beach drains by swash and rip circulation; the U3 shelf+lagoon variant pumped water over the reef (centre mass transport 1.2-1.9 m/s), lowered the offshore level by 0.39 m and widened the focus (P3 proxy 5-9 Hc) [computed]
h0 19 m (not 17 m) keeps the focused crest on the flat at H/Hmax2D 0.84 (P1c 0.83, did not break offshore); at h0 17 m it is 1.00 [computed]
bed.honesty: resembles a steep straight coast; not a measured site

inflow.kind: linear directional monochromatic sea (Airy components, WKB on the slope), complex-amplitude table

focus.rule: all component phases 0 at (x_f, 0) at t = t_f + nT (crest at the focus every period)

main.ramp: half cosine 0.5(1 - cos(pi t / ramp)), t < ramp
main.amplitude_rule: a_sum so that the linear centre-row 2|A|/h first reaches gamma_b = 1.081 at h_b,target 11.0 m (gamma_b from FLIP47 P1c)

focus.rule: all component phases 0 at (x_f, 0) at t = t_f + nT (crest at the focus every period)

fallback.ramp: half cosine 0.5(1 - cos(pi t / ramp)), t < ramp
fallback.amplitude_rule: a_sum so that the linear centre-row 2|A|/h first reaches gamma_b = 1.081 at h_b,target 11.0 m (gamma_b from FLIP47 P1c)

table.tool: g50_dirfield.DirField(T, theta_j, w_j, a_sum, x, bed, x_f).complex_amp / complex_vel(depth_avg=False, z)
table.grid: x 0-212 m, y 0-140 m, 1 m; fields eta_re/im and U_l, V_l re/im at stretched levels z' = 0, -4, -8, -12, -16, -19 m (clipped at -h); one period is enough (time enters as Re(F e^{-i omega t}))
table.vex: target = R(t) E_wall(x) band_factor (F_re cos(omega t) + F_im sin(omega t)); levels interpolated in z' = h (z - eta)/(h + eta) as FLIP45; horizontal velocity only
table.gains: in_gain = sd_gain = 1.0 [chosen; FLIP49 100 m inlet band measured -2.1 % for T 12 s]; checked, not tuned, by SMOKE_D and DM1 generation report

inflow.drift: stage C as plan A: du_abs = -sqrt(g/h0)(mean_T(eta at x 100-110) - reading at 1.0-1.5 s) added to the inlet target u x walltaper

inlet.relaxes: vel.x and vel.z (horizontal) to the table target; never vel.y (vertical) nor the surface

side.rule: FLIP45 g45_tanklib bands(): weight max, target factors multiplied in the corner
side.reflection: not computed (only the U3 generation ratios)

targets48.name: FLIP48 A-frame peak (centre-concentrated narrow plunging crest)
targets48.hc_def: Hc = 真ん中（y 0.5 m の行）の頂の静かな水面からの高さ（巻き始めのコマ）
targets48.width_def: 巻いた全幅 = y = 0 から続く thmax ≥ 90° の行の数 × 格子 × 2（g46_analyze.rows_summary。r4 の各 y の断面）

P1.text: 真ん中（y 0.5 m）が x ≤ 330 m・t ≤ 17.5 s で縦の接線に届く

P2.text: 巻き始めの巻いた全幅 ≤ 2.0 Hc

P3.text: 最も巻いたコマで ≤ 2.5 Hc、真ん中の唇の着水で ≤ 3.0 Hc。剥がれ角 atan(c/v) を書く

P4a.text: 巻き始めの c(0) / 横の端 |y| 70〜84 m（x ≤ 340 m）の頂の平均 ≥ 1.5（≥ 2.0 ははっきり集まった）

P4b.text: 巻き始めの c(0)/c(|y| = 4 Hc) ≥ 1.3、かつ真ん中の着水の前に |y| ≥ 4 Hc の行が巻かない

P5.text: 真ん中の断面（巻き始め〜着水）：前の面の弦 0.1〜0.5 η_c ≥ 55°（良い = 原画の帯 60.5〜78°）、唇 ÷ η_c ≥ 0.2、覆い ÷ η_c² ≥ 0.10

H.text: 海底より下の粒子 < 1e-4、水の量のずれ < 1 %、2 コマ目の確かめ 6 % 以内、静かな水面のずれ < 0.1 m、1 本 30 分以内、mp4 がある

targets48.overall: P1〜P5 を全部満たせば目標どおり。一部だけなら一部と書く。数は AI の読み（自己評価）で、見た目の良し悪しは利用者が決める

definitions.judged_breaker: centre (y 0.5 m row) onset t >= 45 s
definitions.Hc: centre crest above the still level at onset (ana.json onset.eta_c)
definitions.crest_profile: c(y) = per-row maximum of the 3-cell x-median of eta_top over x in [max(150, xc0 - L/2), min(330, xc0 + L/2)], xc0 = centre-row crest x found over [150, 330] in the same frame, L = 149.2 m (T 12 s, linear, h 19 m; fallback T 10 s: 119.0 m) [chosen; g49_periodic_ana.crest_window with cfg sf.L]
definitions.curl_width: 2 x grid x number of contiguous rows from y = 0 with thmax >= 90 deg (g46_analyze.rows_summary on the r4 per-y sections); with r4 recorded every 2nd frame the curl series reads every available frame

P1.text: the y 0.5 m row reaches a vertical tangent inside window k at x <= 330 m (h >= 2.0 m on the 1:10 beach, 20 m before the shoreline x 350.25)

P3.text: <= 2.5 Hc at the most overturned frame and <= 3.0 Hc at centre touchdown; report atan(c/v)

P4a.text: c(0) / mean crest of |y| 70-84 m (x <= 330 m) >= 1.5; >= 2.0 reported as 'clearly focused'. In D this band lies in the shadow of the converging sea (screen c_side 0.03-1.6 m), so P4a passes almost by construction: P4b and c0/c_in carry the narrowing

P4b.text: c(0)/c(|y| = 4 Hc) >= 1.3, and no row at |y| >= 4 Hc curls before centre touchdown

P5.text: centre-section chord over 0.1-0.5 eta_c >= 55 deg (good 60.5-78), lip/eta_c >= 0.2, hood/eta_c^2 >= 0.10; report per breaker and the medians, never best frames only

report_only.text: judged in FLIP49 (PER2-PER5) and shown in A's table, but not part of A's verdict (stated openly)

limits: at most 2 follow-up runs in D, then stop and show the user
